mapper.update: UPDATE TOUR_SYNC_STATE SET RUNNING_YN = 'Y', SYNC_ID = #{syncId}, STARTED_AT = #{startedAt}, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT = #{leaseExpiresAt}, STARTED_BY = #{manager} WHERE LOCK_ID = 1 AND ( RUNNING_YN = 'N' OR LEASE_EXPIRES_AT <= #{startedAt} )
UPDATE TOUR_SYNC_STATE SET RUNNING_YN = 'N', SYNC_ID = NULL, STARTED_AT = NULL, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT = NULL, STARTED_BY = NULL WHERE LOCK_ID = 1 AND SYNC_ID = #{syncId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TOUR_SYNC_HISTORY ( SYNC_ID, STARTED_AT, CHANGED_COUNT, FAILED_COUNT, SYNC_STATUS, MANAGER ) VALUES ( #{syncId}, #{startedAt}, #{changedCount}, #{failedCount}, #{status}, #{manager} )
mapper.select: SELECT SYNC_ID, STARTED_AT, CHANGED_COUNT, FAILED_COUNT, SYNC_STATUS, MANAGER FROM ( SELECT SYNC_ID, STARTED_AT, CHANGED_COUNT, FAILED_COUNT, SYNC_STATUS, MANAGER FROM TOUR_SYNC_HISTORY ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC, SYNC_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TOUR_SYNC_STATE WHERE LOCK_ID = 1 AND RUNNING_YN = 'Y' AND LEASE_EXPIRES_AT > #{now}
